We offer instruction courses at all three locations, for your convenience. Come visit us at Carolina Beach, Hammocks Beach, and Topsail Beach. quotes.text: Can't say enough nice things about the staff! Extremely responsive to any and every question prior to tour. Then both the young adults leading our 2 hour excursion were hard-working and beyond...diplomatic is the best word I can come up with? Is it possible to be both stoic and cheerful? Because they are! Thanks so much for pulling us out of the literal weeds repeatedly, and I personally really appreciated the effort put forth to brush off just how much work we gave you both. Oddly I totally loved kayaking in the choppy water, I just won't be getting a tandem kayak next time lol!

Rented a tandem yak to take my 4 year old granddaughter on a 2 hour paddle. Mark was helpful, courteous and very friendly. The yak was ready with paddles and jackets. The dock had several yak launch sites. The laminated map was a great addition!! We had the BEST time and plan on returning soon. My compliments to a well organized, professional and friendly host!!

We had a great time on our kayaking trip. They let us know we'll before hand about bad weather so we postponed it to the next day. We show up and the wind was blowing pretty hard. We switched it again to the following morning. It was just my daughter, the guide and I. The flexibility with scheduling was great. Definitely recommend.
We had a wonderful time! My family chose to kayak and paddle board on our own but the young man took extra time and effort getting us set up and ensuring that we felt comfortable. Thank you again!
We rented kayaks from pPddle NC for our trip out to Bear Island from Hammocks Beach SP on July 3. Great boats, great service, and a great experience! Highly recommend!
